description:
Fetch one contact: name, phone number and activity timestamps.

`first_messaged_at` is when a message from this number first reached
them on WhatsApp, and `last_interaction_at` is the last message that
passed in EITHER direction, so it moves when they write to you as well.
A message that failed before reaching WhatsApp moves neither.

`refresh` shows the last `refresh_contact` you asked for: when it was
requested, when it finished, and its `outcome` (`updated`, `unchanged`,
`number_not_connected` or `unavailable`). While `completed_at` is null
it is still running.

The id must belong to the inbox named by `number_alias`. An id from a
different number returns not found even though the person exists.

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
